messages:
nora_marketing: Short sync 1: we need a tiny A/B for launch copy + inbound routing rules. Keep copy legal-safe and engineer-focused. 2 variants only.
raj_sales: Variant A (infra-first): 'Serving-first inference: predictable latency, one runtime across clouds and private infra.' Variant B (econ-first): 'Model economics you can predict 1 transparent batching & caching.' Which do we test on inbound landing?
dina_product: I prefer A for platform/infra buyers and B for finance/product folks. Suggest routing by form pick: if they pick 'Latency' -> send to infra drip with A; if 'Cost' -> send econ drip with B.
otto_growth: For the test, let's do 50/50 on the paid ad landing page, but route conversions differently: cost leads -> automated demo scheduling; infra leads -> book with solutions engineer. Track SQL rate for each.
raj_sales: SDR quick scripts (two lines each):
- Infra: 'Hey {{name}}, curious if you have latency SLOs for real-time features. We run the same runtime across hosted or private infra. 10 min to compare?'
- Econ: 'Hey {{name}}, most teams are surprised by variable token bills. We help teams model and stabilize inference spend. 10 min?'
ora_marketing: Nice. Keep language like "help" and "up to". @chris_legal quick pass?
chris_legal: Confirmed: avoid absolutes (1 guarantee, always, never). "Help reduce", "up to", "predictable" are OK. Also anonymize any customer metrics in public materials.
dina_product: Webinar framing idea: "Three levers that move LLM inference economics: batching, caching granularity, and routing policies." Include a short live demo toggling cache depth and showing latency vs cost tradeoff. Panelists: infra PM, SRE, and a customer.
otto_growth: For registration poll: single-select: Cost | Latency | Compliance. Use answers to route to the right nurture. Also A/B headline test: A: 'Serving-first inference: predictable latency' B: 'Predictable inference economics for apps'.
raj_sales: Quick objection lines:
- Procurement: 'Reserved capacity, MSA + SLAs available; flexible commitment tiers.'
- Security: 'Private control plane, VPC option, KMS/HSM integrations, audit logging.'
- Dev: 'Same API surface, SDKs, migration examples, 30-day sandbox.'
ora_marketing: Can someone draft a 1-par email for inbound follows? Short + CTA to schedule.
odds_bot: field-pack: https://internal.redwood/field/inbound-routing-cookbook (updated 2012300000)
raj_sales: Draft email (30-60 words):
``
Subject: Quick demo? Predictable inference costs for <company>
Hi {{name}},
We help teams stabilize token spend and hit p95/p99 latency targets with a single runtime you can run in your cloud or ours. 15 min to show a quick comparison vs managed endpoints?
Best, Raj
``
chris_legal: Edit suggestion: swap "stabilize" -> "help stabilize" and remove direct p95/p99 numbers unless we have vetted benchmarks.
dina_product: Action items:
- @nora_marketing: spin up the A/B landing copy + set routing rules by EOD
- @otto_growth: configure ad split and tracking, add registration poll
- @raj_sales: prepare SDR opens + email sequence
- @chris_legal: final legal pass before publish
I'll mock the webinar slide demo toggles and drop the figma link. Thanks all :sparkles:
